correctness.rationale: Canonical-model automorphisms and the projective-elation kernel lemma reduce projection fibers to 21 explicit matrices; invariant quartic local computation proves all quasi centers outer. Two differently organized exhaustive enumerators, each using exact Gröbner unit ideal conditions over F2, give compatible 17-class/1184-equation profiles and 78 overall smooth orbits; detailed output and executable code are embedded.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The 2003 Nart–Ritzenthaler binary-genus-three classification gives full normal models and abstract arithmetic automorphism descriptions, so it strongly overlaps and plausibly allows the new statistic to be reconstructed. It does not itself state the seven-center-by-center arithmetic elation distribution; the new statement is a derived explicit projection-kernel refinement, not an independent new classification of quartic curves. Full potential implicit coverage is a residual priority risk. The 2022 quasi-Galois paper assumes characteristic zero, so its arrangements do not directly imply characteristic-two wild kernel frequencies.
